units.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net reads and writes CFB containers and MSG documents. It converts between EML and MSG formats through a built-in MIME implementation. It supports high-level message creation, editing, and property access, and provides low-level access to CFB structure.
It reads MSG files from streams or files using MapiMessage.FromStream and writes them back with Save, preserving MAPI structure and metadata.
It creates new messages with MapiMessage.Create, sets sender and recipient details, attaches files via streams, and saves the result as a complete MSG file.
It converts EML files to MSG using MapiMessage.LoadFromEml and back to EML using SaveToEml, handling MIME parsing and serialization natively without external dependencies.
It opens CFB containers from files with CfbReader.FromFile, exposing sector size, directory entry count, and tree traversal via IterTree to inspect internal structure.
It reads and writes arbitrary MAPI properties on messages using SetProperty and GetPropertyValue, beyond the strongly-typed properties exposed directly by MapiMessage.
It adds recipients with AddRecipient and attaches files or embedded messages with AddAttachment and AddEmbeddedMessageAttachment, supporting both external and nested content.
It populates a read-only ValidationIssues list on loaded messages or MSG documents whenever strict parsing encounters structural anomalies.
It builds CFB containers programmatically using CfbDocument, CfbStorage, and CfbStream, then serializes them to files or byte arrays with CfbWriter.WriteFile or CfbWriter.ToBytes.
This example reads a MSG file and prints its subject line using Aspose.Email.Foss version 26.7.0 for net8.0.
The following examples demonstrate creating and saving MSG messages, converting EML to MSG, and inspecting CFB container structures.
Create and save an MSG message with sender, recipient, and attachment.
Convert an EML file to MSG and back to EML.
Inspect the CFB container structure of an MSG file.
Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net provides high-level message handling through MapiMessage and lower-level access via CfbReader and MsgReader for direct container and document inspection.

The Aspose.Email.Foss package version 26.7.0 targets net8.0 and exposes MapiMessage for creating, editing, and converting messages, as well as CfbReader for inspecting the underlying CFB container structure.
The getting started guide covers installation, walkthroughs, and feature guides for this library.
The how-to guides and FAQ provide task-focused answers for common MSG, CFB, and EML questions.
The full API reference offers the complete, browsable reference for all 29 public types.
The public API summary lists the repository's own stable-namespace and primary-type list.
The changelog documents the release history.
Users can open issues on GitHub for bug reports or feature requests.

Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net reads and writes local email files in formats supported by the Aspose.Email.Foss package version 26.7.0 for .NET 8.0, including MSG, EML, MHTML, and others, without requiring a commercial license.
The library does not connect to mail servers and provides no IMAP, SMTP, or POP3 support, and it does not parse or generate TNEF (winmail.dat) files.
Calendar and appointment functionality is not available; calendar-specific MAPI properties can only be accessed generically via SetProperty() and GetPropertyValue().
The package requires .NET 8.0 or later and does not support classic .NET Framework (4.x).
The package targets net8.0 and requires the .NET 8.0 SDK (or later) to build and the matching .NET 8.0 runtime (or later) to run.

Aspose.Email FOSS for .Net targets net8.0 and is built using the .NET CLI. The test suite in tests/Aspose.Email.Foss.Tests/Aspose.Email.Foss.Tests.csproj uses xUnit 2.5.3 with Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.8.0 and xunit.runner.visualstudio 2.5.3, and includes coverlet.collector 6.0.0 for code-coverage collection; these dependencies apply only to the test project and are not referenced by the main library. The test suite asserts CFB round-trips, MSG reading, and EML round-trip conversion through classes such as CfbRoundTripTests, MsgReaderTests, MapiMessageTests, MapiMessageEmlTests, and MetadataSmokeTests. Example programs in examples/ demonstrate usage and can be run directly with dotnet run.

It adds broader format and protocol coverage: direct IMAP/SMTP/POP3 mail-server connectivity, TNEF (winmail.dat) support, calendar and appointment APIs, and classic .NET Framework support alongside this edition's MSG, CFB, and EML processing.

CfbConstants class defines constants used in Compound File Binary structures, including ByteOrderLittleEndian for little-endian encoding, MAXREGSECT and MAXREGSID for maximum sector and stream identifiers, and MiniStreamCutoffSize for the maximum size of streams stored in the mini stream.

CfbDocument class represents a Compound File Binary document and provides methods to load from a file, stream, or reader, exposing properties such as MajorVersion, MinorVersion, TransactionSignatureNumber, and Root.
CfbException class is the exception type used for errors in Compound File Binary processing and provides a constructor for initialization.
CfbNode class holds metadata for a Compound File Binary node, including Clsid, CreationTime, ModifiedTime, Name, and StateBits.

CfbReader class reads Compound File Binary files and provides access to header, directory entries, FAT, DIFAT, MiniFAT, and mini stream data, with methods to find children, iterate tree structures, and retrieve stream data; its constructor throws ArgumentNullException conditionally, and GetEntry and GetStreamData throw CfbException conditionally.

CfbStorage class represents a storage node in a Compound File Binary document and provides methods to add child storages and streams, exposing properties such as Children, Clsid, CreationTime, ModifiedTime, and Name.
CfbStream class represents a stream node in a Compound File Binary document and provides access to its data, Clsid, CreationTime, ModifiedTime, Name, and StateBits.
CfbWriter class writes Compound File Binary documents and provides methods ToBytes and WriteFile.
DirectoryEntry class provides methods to determine whether a directory entry is a root, storage, or stream.
DirectoryEntryNameComparer class provides a Compare method to compare directory entry names.
Header class exposes read-only properties MiniSectorSize and SectorSize for the sector and mini sector sizes in a Compound File Binary file.

MapiAttachment class represents a MAPI attachment and provides properties for ContentId, Data, EmbeddedMessage, Filename, and methods to load from bytes or stream, as well as read-only properties IsEmbeddedMessage and IsStorageAttachment.

MapiMessage class represents a MAPI message and provides methods to add attachments and recipients, exposing properties such as Attachments and Body, and constants AttachMethodByValue, AttachMethodEmbedded, and AttachMethodStorage.
MapiProperty class represents a MAPI property and provides properties for Flags, PropertyId, PropertyTag, PropertyType, and Value, and a constructor for initialization.
MapiPropertyCollection class provides methods to add, get, set, and remove MAPI properties, and to iterate over properties.
MapiRecipient class represents a MAPI recipient and provides properties for AddressType, DisplayName, EmailAddress, RecipientType, and a read-only property for Properties.

MsgConstants class defines constants used in MSG files, including AttachmentStoragePrefix for attachment storage names, EmbeddedMessageStorageName for embedded message substorage, MaxAttachmentStorages and MaxRecipientStorages for limits, and property attribute constants.

MsgDocument class represents an MSG file document and provides methods to load from a file or stream, exposing properties such as MajorVersion, MinorVersion, Root, and Strict, and a method ToCfbDocument.
MsgException class is the exception type used for errors in MSG processing and provides a constructor for initialization.
MsgReader class reads MSG files and provides methods to load from a file or stream, a method to dispose resources, and a read-only property ValidationIssues.

MsgStorage class represents an MSG storage object and provides methods to add storages and streams, find storages and streams, and exposes properties such as Clsid, CreationTime, and ModifiedTime; its constructor throws ArgumentNullException conditionally.
MsgStorageRole enum lists the roles of MSG storage objects, including Attachment, EmbeddedMessage, Generic, Message, and Recipient.
MsgStream class represents an MSG stream object and provides properties for Clsid, CreationTime, Data, ModifiedTime, Name, and StateBits; its constructor throws ArgumentNullException conditionally.
MsgWriter class writes MSG files and provides methods ToBytes and WriteFile.
